_note: MEarth South (CTIO) roll-off roof: Alpaca Dome over the parallel-port roof interface box (docs/mearth_roof.md).
Hardware is NOT allowed: allow_hardware stays false until every item under 'Confirm on site' in docs/mearth_roof.md is checked.
Then: allow_hardware true here AND --hardware on the command line, on the computer the roof interface box is cabled to.
port.device is a placeholder for that computer's parallel port.
open_timeout/close_timeout: legacy South values (180 s). departure_timeout is new and unconfirmed (time for the roof to leave its starting limit).
No hardware heartbeat exists on this roof: the enclosure config (mearth_south.json) is attended only.
name: mearth-south
